title: Making a StS-like where you build cards on a grid, almost all code and art by AI
author: JaeHeum
selftext:
I'm making a deckbuilder inspired by Slay the Spire, except the cards are buildings and you place them on tiles, kind of like a backpack game.



When I started, I'd sort out the code structure and task docs with Claude, hand the work to Codex, then have Claude review it.

These days I mostly just code with Opus 5.5 and only use Codex for image generation.

The structure was already set up, so Opus 5.5 follows it pretty well, and it's cheaper on tokens than the GPT models in Codex.

For bigger tasks I still have them review each other.



For images, I picked one image as the base and generated everything from that, then kept reusing the prompt that made it.

So basically the design and code structure are mine, and the actual code and images are AI.



If I had one tip: set up a good test environment. AI makes mistakes, but if it can catch them and redo the work on its own, you don't have to babysit it.



The demo is up on Steam now. I'd love feedback from both people who've played StS and people who haven't.

Thanks for reading, happy to answer any questions about the workflow.
